Operator-commissioned (SP/Baixada rotation). Café Carioca, Praça Visc. de Mauá 1, Centro Histórico, Santos — founded 24 Nov 1939 on Rua Dom Pedro II by four partners (per juicysantos.com.br/comida/cafe-carioca-85-anos and the official site's own history page), moved to its current Praça Mauá corner on 24 Nov 1940. Counter-service pastelaria/bar, no seating tradition confirmed via Google Maps listing description ('ambiente clássico de bar com ares de boteco') and multiple recent Google reviews describing it as a stand-up counter. Signature dishes pastel de siri, pastel de camarão and bolinho de bacalhau confirmed via juicysantos.com.br and cafecarioca.com.br. HISTORICAL-FIGURE CLAIMS — verified before use, each against at least two independent sources: Getúlio Vargas, Jânio Quadros, Hortência confirmed via juicysantos.com.br/comida/restaurantes-tradicionais-em-santos AND the official Santos Municipal Council press page (camarasantos.sp.gov.br, covering the 2005 commemorative plaque, itself a primary institutional record); Nuno Leal Maia and Ary Toledo confirmed via the same camarasantos.sp.gov.br piece AND bs9.com.br's 85th-anniversary coverage. No claim ran on a single unconfirmed source. Diário do Litoral ran two pieces calling it Santos's most famous pastel and covering it as a tourist landmark; not yet in content/sources.md — logged to content/preferred-sources.md as a candidate. juicy-santos (trusted, auto) named this venue directly in its '5 restaurantes tradicionais de Santos' piece. Research floor: multi-source pass completed above; Reddit search (site search + reddit.com direct via claude-in-chrome) returned zero threads mentioning the venue — logged as none-found, not skipped; Google reviews read via claude-in-chrome (4.4/3,764 reviews) — recent reviews flag inconsistent quality on some pastel fillings (palmito, bolinho de carne) alongside strong praise for the classic flavors and tradition, quoted in-body with dates. Five-plus preferred sources consulted: juicy-santos (x2), official site, BS9, câmara municipal press page. No dated near-term event surfaced for this venue specifically beyond the recurring weekly 'Segunda Deu Samba' live-music night, which is evergreen, not a single dated event — not nested as a child event page. Distinct register from made-cozinha-autoral-santos (contemporary tasting menu) and restaurante-almeida-santos (formal dining room) — this is the standing-counter, no-chairs local-legend entry filling that gap in Near's Santos food-drink coverage.
